CVE-2026-46529.title: Amazon Linux 2023 - ALAS2023-2026-1782: Important priority package update for papers
CVE-2026-46529.description: CVE-2026-46529 is a command injection vulnerability in Evince, Atril, and Xreader caused by missing quoting of shell-like input in ev_spawn() in ev-application.c.
